Hi! My name is Afifa, I'm calling from FortuneMarq Media & Marketing — we're a digital growth agency based right here in [City].

objections.response: No problem — I'll be very quick. We have data specific to your business in [City] that I think you'd want to know. If it's not relevant I'll let you go straight away.
That's completely fine. I just want to share one insight — it's about how people are finding your type of business in [City] right now. 30 seconds, that's all.

lines.text: The search volume for [Niche] in [City] is [Search Volume] per month — smaller than some other niches.

lines.condition: Pause — let it land, then reframe
lines.text: [PAUSE] But here's what makes it interesting — every single person searching is ready to buy. This is high intent, low competition. The people searching for [Niche] in [City] are not browsing — they have a specific need and they're ready to act.

objections.trigger: Where did you get this data?
objections.response: It comes from Google's own data tools plus local market research we did specifically for [City]. I can share what we found on WhatsApp if you'd like to see it before the meeting.

objections.trigger: We get enough business through referrals
objections.response: Referrals are great — the most trusted source. But there's a whole layer of potential customers who don't know anyone who can refer them, so they search online and whoever shows up first gets that business. That's what the meeting covers.

lines.text: The search volume for [Niche] in [City] is [Search Volume] per month — smaller than some niches. But every single person searching is ready to buy. High intent, low competition. And right now, most of that demand has no strong local business to land on.

Most businesses in your category in [City] are completely invisible online. So whoever builds their presence first effectively owns those searches — and once that trust is established with customers, it becomes very hard for others to catch up.

objections.trigger: The volume seems low — is it worth it?
objections.response: That's a fair question. But think about it this way — [Search Volume] people every month who are specifically searching for exactly what you do, with no competition. Even converting 10% of that is significant. The meeting will show you what that translates to in actual revenue.

lines.text: We help local [Niche] businesses show up on Google directly — not through JustDial, not through directories. Your own website, your own Google ranking, your own enquiries coming straight to you.
We've built this system specifically for local businesses in [City]. Everything is connected — the website, the SEO, the Google presence — and we manage it so you don't have to.

What I want to do is set up a 15-minute call with Jabeer, our founder. He'll show you exactly where the demand in your category is actually coming from in [City], how to capture it, and what a realistic growth path looks like for your niche.
There's no cost, no commitment. Just 15 minutes and you'll know exactly where you stand. Would sometime this week or next work for you?

lines.condition: If wants to think / see something first
lines.text: Absolutely — I'll send you the report on WhatsApp right now so you can have a look. And whenever you're ready, we'll set up the 15 minutes with Jabeer.
It's completely free, no commitment at all. Jabeer just walks you through your data — you decide if there's anything worth acting on.

objections.response: Jabeer will cover all of that in the meeting — packages and pricing based on what actually makes sense for your business. The meeting itself is completely free.

objections.trigger: We tried digital marketing before and it didn't work
objections.response: That happens a lot — most agencies just run ads with no foundation underneath. What we do is different: we build the whole system first. The 15-minute call is the best way to show you what that difference looks like in practice.

objections.trigger: The owner isn't available / Someone else handles this
objections.response: No problem — when is the owner usually free? Jabeer can speak directly with them. Or I can WhatsApp the report first so they can have a look before we set up the call.

objections.trigger: Just send me information on WhatsApp
objections.response: Of course — I'll send the report right now. Have a look whenever you get a chance, and then the 15 minutes with Jabeer will make a lot more sense. I'll follow up in a couple of days.
Absolutely, take your time. I'll send the report on WhatsApp and follow up in a couple of days — no pressure. The meeting is free, no commitment, Jabeer just walks you through the data.

objections.trigger: We handle marketing internally / We have someone
objections.response: Good to know. The 15-minute call might still be useful — Jabeer can show you what the market data says and you can see if there are gaps worth filling. Even as a second opinion, most business owners find it valuable.
